description: Type in notes and instantly find every matching scale — all major modes, pentatonics, blues, harmonic minor and more.

faqs.a: Notes you type are matched as subsets of each scale across all 12 roots. Exact matches (same notes) rank first, then partial matches by coverage.
Write note names separated by spaces, e.g. "C E G" or "A C D E G". Use # and b for sharps and flats.
18 scale types × 12 roots = 216 scales are checked against your notes.
faqs.q: How many scales does it check?

howto: Type your notes separated by spaces (e.g. C D E F# G A B).
Exact matches appear first with a badge; partial matches follow with coverage %.
Click any result to see the full scale notes.
title: Scale Finder
